sentences.en: If you're going to disseminate ideas, make sure they're worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 如果你要传播想法，确保它们是有价值的。

sentences.en: Disseminating knowledge is not the mission of the website.
sentences.zh: 这个网站的任务并不是传播知识。

sentences.en: This publication disseminates important information regarding the state of this country's politics.
sentences.zh: 这份出版物传播了关于国家政治状况的重要信息。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dis（加强）+semin（种子）+ ate →散布种子→散布，传播
